groups.summary: Public type exports and small contract helpers.
Canonical database configuration, migrations, and SQL verification.

Explicit type generation, disposable-database maintenance, and schema-workspace generation. The committed workspace/ tree is generated by scripts/schema-workspace and must not receive hand-written or generated docs files: workspace:validate rejects any file the generator did not render.

modules.summary: Type-only Database/API/pre-research exports and provenance constants/helpers.
interface: Package exports for pinned database consumers.
constraints: database.generated.ts is generated output; inspect it explicitly when needed rather than including its full contents in the map.

modules.summary: Shared Supabase configuration and ordered migration authority.
interface: Ordered migrations and database configuration; consumers do not own another shared migration tree.

modules.summary: Supabase/native type generation and drift checking.
interface: Generation/check scripts with explicit database-target validation.

modules.summary: Allows reset only for explicitly disposable databases.
constraints: Never use a map or a documentation job to bypass the shared-data reset guard.

modules.summary: Ordered, idempotent, interrupt-safe install of an AI Engineer database: pinned knowledge_verification component (KS CLI), domain migrations, custody/grant verification, KS executor seal-key registration (KS CLI `seal-key`), Mission Control common release (mission-db), JSON receipt; plus the confirm-target remote reinstall and the manifest-bounded wipe with dry-run.
constraints: Disposable Supabase workdirs (disposable-*/vfy-* project id, matching container labels), or an explicit MC target.toml with --remote-reinstall/wipe behind the exact project_ref:installation_id confirmation, credential-endpoint match with TLS, and identity (installation row, exact route, or fresh management-API evidence for a legacy Mission Control).

Wipe drops only the pinned manifest public/storage objects, the allow-listed schemas (domain, knowledge, Mission Control incl. legacy capability_search) and the CLI ledger; never a database, the public schema, extension-owned objects, buckets or stored objects. install-manifest.json is regenerated from the migrations, never hand-edited.
Verifies grants and custody owned by migrations; never re-issues component DDL or domain grants.

modules.summary: Introspects pg_catalog into schema-ir.v1, merges curated enrichment, renders the committed workspace, and checks or validates drift; owns the committed workspace/ tree (ai-engineer-schema-workspace/3), which is read by id starting at workspace/manifest.json and never enumerated.
interface: cli.mjs: introspect, build, check, validate, materialize, enrich. npm workspace:build, workspace:check, workspace:validate, workspace:materialize. Enrichment also has relations, terminology, tasks, ingestion-rules YAML; scopes also has full.json and ingestion-author.json.
constraints: workspace/ is generated by npm run workspace:build; edit workspace-enrichment/ or the generator, never the tree.
workspace/ contains only generator output: CI fails on drift (workspace:check) or on any file the generator did not render (workspace:validate).

routes.task: Change the schema workspace generator or enrichment
